content.background_rule: All canonical autosomal Ensembl 116 exons, any transcript/biotype, plus 20 bp flanks; merge overlapping/bookended BED intervals; bcftools view -R --regions-overlap 1. No gene/score selection.
content.spike_rule: Replace any background record at each source causal position, then add source allele/genotype unphased. Record collisions. Normalise multiallelic records with bcftools norm -m -any before merging. Preserve all other observed autosomal genotypes.
content.analysis_rule: Reconstructed 15.1.0 exome template unchanged across cases. Same variant sources/filters and inheritance modes. Original/half/swapped differ only in HPO list. None removes hiPhivePrioritiser and supplies no HPO; OMIM inheritance prior remains.
content.outcomes: Primary: source-designated causal gene rank and top-1/5/10 over nine provisional autosomal source-label comparators, failures count as not recovered. PAX4 is separately reported as disputed truth after pre-result primary-source adjudication; its paper calls the variant VUS. Report both minimum and maximum tied rank; success uses conservative maximum rank. Keep all twelve cases and all four arms visible. Two X cases reported separately because background lacks X; ZIC3 also has unresolved source-phenotype conflict.

content.scope: Invocation only; all job SHA256 values unchanged. No inference started or result viewed.

content.type: Cache-only operational relaunch; not an initial pre-inference plan
content.reason: The first two HG002 analyses took116.446s/105.701s, with repeated external database reads. jcmd reported ~1.93GiB heap used against12GiB limit. Increase bounded cache60000to300000; no allele/phenotype/filter/prioritiser changes.
content.result_selection: Run all48jobs again, not just failures. Compare all completed first-attempt outputs, regardless of outcome. No case, source group, endpoint or analysis rule chosen using results.
content.score_inspection: Parent inspected only runtime/progress and output membership for this benchmark before relaunch; prior FGFR2 results were viewed and remain a separate control.

content.scope: All new twelve-case runs on both HG002/HG001, all four HPO arms. Historical reconstruction unchanged.
content.reason: Remove the default ClinVar variant filter-bypass whitelist before evaluation.
content.remaining_leakage: Disabling filter bypass does not remove ClinVar annotations, model training knowledge, phenotype-disease associations or prior knowledge of known cases. This is not a novel-gene benchmark.

content.additional_background: GIAB HG001 NA12878 NISTv4.2.1 GRCh38 autosomal benchmark
content.preparation: Use exactly the same existing frozen exon/flank rule, case/allele/phenotype selection and analysis. Do not combine genotypes across backgrounds. Report each background separately and paired case-level recovery in both.
content.denominator: Nine provisional autosomal source-label cases per background, not eighteen independent diseases or genomes from those patients. Retain PAX4 and the two X controls separately on each background.
content.reason: Check sensitivity to a different public genetic background before any observed outcomes; synthetic cases are not clinical validation.

content.additional_diagnostic: After unchanged primary gene-ranking evaluation, compare every frozen causal allele to the source-gene JSON variantEvaluations by exact GRCh38 coordinate/REF/ALT. Retain filter, contribution and whitelist flags. Unmatched variants require representation review; gene recovery is not allele recovery. No membership, arms, thresholds, filters or primary endpoints changed.
content.phenotype_only_export: Use TSV_GENE phenotype score, maximum across inheritance modes per unique gene; conservative ties at four-decimal exported precision. Twelve pre-frozen original-HPO jobs, no VCF. Knowledge comparator, not a second genomic benchmark.

source_groups.scope: Source support, not clinical accuracy. Preserve both original4/3/2 sensitivity and current4/5 map distinctly. All rows and arms remain; subsequent coverage findings append without silently changing this freeze.

content.purpose: Retain all nine primary source-label cases and report sensitivity for the original4/3/2 groups and current4/5 evidence map. Source support is not independent clinical truth. All twelve cases, four arms and two backgrounds unchanged.

content.scope: 39 main figures and available case-relevant supplements now visually reviewed; exact residual coverage gaps retained. Source groups/cases/arms unchanged. FGFR2 reconstruction has started; no twelve-case or phenotype-only inference has started and none of their results has been inspected.

findings.ZIC3: Original paper distinguishes selected sister III.3 asplenia from brother III.2 polysplenia. Frozen packet contains cross-individual positive phenotype; do not repair post-selection.
findings.OFD1: Exact allele unresolved: frozen c.2122_2125dup and figure-derived c.2123_2126dupAAGA have different reference strings and canonical representations. Main text/sequence figure conflict; gene recovery cannot validate the frozen allele.
